name: fit-bar
title: Fit bar
description: Stepped holes, D-bores and M3 pilots in one solid block, all blind from the top so the first layer is a plain rectangle. Numbers 3, 4 and 5 on the measuring sheet.

row.rule: Between rows, with room for the labels

height.rule: Deep enough for 6 mm bores over a solid floor

corner.rule: The footprint's corners, rounded so they stay down

hole_from.rule: Row 1, plain holes: an M3 screw's clearance, around where it should come out

hole_depth.rule: Deep enough to gauge with a drill shank or calipers

bore_from.rule: Row 2, D-bores for the 5 mm NEMA shaft: drawn diameter

bore_depth.rule: The shaft goes in this far

pilot_from.rule: Row 3, pilots for an M3 screw to self-tap

press_base.rule: What bore() draws for the press fit before compensation, 5 - 2 × 0.02

segments.rule: Facets on round holes and corners
